summary: The Petitioner, JSW Power Trading Company Limited, has filed the present Petition for the upgradation of its inter-State trading licence in electricity from Category ‘III’ to Category ‘II’ from 1.4.2025. Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 1 3. Subsequently, the Petitioner filed Petition No. 75/MP/2017 for transfer of the trading licence from JSW Power Trading Company Limited to JSW Green Energy Limited and to record the name of the transferee company from “JSW Green Energy Limited” to “JSW Power Trading Company Limited” in terms of the Scheme of Arrangement approved by the National Company Law Tribunal vide order dated 9.3.2017. The Commission, vide its order dated 1.2.2018, accorded in-principle approval for the transfer of the trading licence of JSW Power Trading Company Limited to JSW Green Energy Limited and granted liberty to the Petitioner to approach the Commission for the change of name of the Petitioner’s company after approval from the Registrar of Companies for the same. 5. Subsequently, on the request of the Petitioner, the Commission, vide order dated 4.3.2020 in Petition No. 20/TD/2020, down-graded the trading licence of the Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 2 Petitioner from the Category ‘I’ to Category ‘IV’ in terms of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Trading license and other related matters) Regulations, 2020 (hereinafter referred to as 2020 Trading Licence Regulations) with effect from 1.4.2020. 6. Further, the Petitioner approached the Commission for the upgradation of the trading licence from Category ‘IV’ to Category ‘III’. After examination of the documents available on the record, the Commission, vide order dated 16.2.2024 in Petition No. 371/TD/2023, upgraded the trading licence of the Petitioner from the Category ‘IV’ to Category ‘III’ as per the 2020 Trading Licence Regulations with effect from 1.4.2023. 7. The Petitioner has submitted that, in view of the improvement in power demand, the competitive dynamics of Power Exchanges, the anticipated growth in the power market, and the prospective business potential in power trading, the Petitioner seeks an up-gradation of its existing trading licence from Category ‘III’ to Category ‘II’. The Petitioner has submitted that it intends to engage in trading activities up to a quantum of 7,000 MUs annually. The Petitioner has further stated that its trading volumes have shown a consistent increase over the past five years, and that, in the course of the Financial Year 2024–25, the total trading quantum surpassed the stipulated threshold of 110% as prescribed under Regulation 9(3) of the Trading Licence Regulations, 2020, due to inadvertence and oversight. It has also been submitted that, prior to the filing of the present Petition, the Petitioner remitted an amount of Rs. 9,00,000/- representing the differential licence fee payable between Category ‘II’ and Category ‘III’ for the financial year 2024–25. Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 3 8. The matter was called out for the hearing on 29.7.2025. The representative of the Petitioner reiterated the submissions made in the instant Petition and further submitted that the Petitioner fulfils all the requirements of Category-II Inter-State trading licence as stipulated in the Trading Licence Regulations, 2020, as amended from time to time. 9. Vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 29.7.2025, the Petitioner was directed to file an Audited Special Balance Sheet as on any date falling within 30 days immediately preceding the date of filing of the Petition, i.e., 03.06.2025, on an affidavit, within a week, i.e., by 06.08.2025. 10. The Petitioner, vide Affidavit dated 12.8.2025, has submitted the information called for, which has been dealt with in the succeeding paragraphs. 11. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. Regulation 9(4) of the Trading Licence Regulations 2020 provides as under: Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 4 _(b) The Trading Licensee shall file an application before the Commission for upgradation of its licence to a higher category as soon as he expects the trading volume to exceed the trading volume limit specified for the Trading Licensee’s existing category._ _(c) The Trading Licensee shall be granted an opportunity of being heard by the Commission before taking a decision on the application._ Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 5 Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 6 16. Based on the above, the net worth, current ratio and liquidity ratio of the Petitioner are as under: Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 7 18. Let an extract copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (Ministry of Power) and the Central Electricity Authority in terms of sub-section (7) of Section 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for their information and record. 19. We direct that necessary endorsement be made on the licence issued to the applicant with regard to the change of Category of the licensee. Order in Petition No. 668/TD/2025 Page 8 CERC Website S.
